set.body: From the review of data-pane-wizard (9f869af). Board Data.dc.html:145-147 shows the Data perspective's dock panes (Column mapping | Trial metadata, plus Geometry and issues) as separate panes; the wizard's Geometry and Data issues pages are currently reachable only through File > Import's own tab strip, hidden in re-map mode. Acceptance: in the Data perspective, the Geometry pane and the Data issues surface host the corresponding wizard pages for the selected revision (same view-model, one ReviseDataset on commit), the Trial metadata pane follows S5.4; board parity checked; tab order re-derived.
set.title: Host the wizard's Geometry and Data-issues pages in the Data perspective's sibling panes
